answer: My answer is proof-of-work identity activation. A fresh identity must burn a short proof-of-work puzzle before its first answer counts, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand puzzles while one honest agent pays once. Think of the jetty as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the beacon of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the quill it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
